entries.EN: . Is the info trustworthy?

entries.EN: . How come? It happened not long ago!

entries.EN: ! Damn it... Are you sure?

entries.EN: ! Shit! Can't you have told us that earlier?! If this is a prank, I'll kill you!
entries.JA_current: ! Shit! Can't you have told us that earlier?! If this is a prank, I'll kill you!
entries.JA_new: ！くそっ！もっと早く言えよ！悪ふざけだったら殺すからな！

entries.EN: . Is the data confirmed?
entries.JA_current: . Is the data confirmed?
entries.JA_new: 。データは確認済みなのか？

entries.EN: It's certain. Everybody, batten down!
entries.JA_current: It's certain. Everybody, batten down!
entries.JA_new: 間違いない。みんな、しっかり避難しろ！

entries.EN: The info has been confirmed!
entries.JA_current: The info has been confirmed!
entries.JA_new: 情報は確認済みだ！

entries.EN: The source is absolutely trustworthy! Let's burrow!
entries.JA_current: The source is absolutely trustworthy! Let's burrow!
entries.JA_new: 情報源は確かだ！すぐ隠れろ！

entries.EN: The data is correct! Bunker down, fellas!
entries.JA_current: The data is correct! Bunker down, fellas!
entries.JA_new: データは正しい！みんな、避難しろ！

entries.EN: My source of info never misses! This is for real!
entries.JA_current: My source of info never misses! This is for real!
entries.JA_new: 俺の情報源は外さない！本当だぞ！

entries.EN: Yes, everything's verified, without a doubt!
entries.JA_current: Yes, everything's verified, without a doubt!
entries.JA_new: ああ、間違いなく確認した！

entries.EN: Ya don't believe? Take a walk! How'd ya like your grave to be decorated?
entries.JA_current: Ya don't believe? Take a walk! How'd ya like your grave to be decorated?
entries.JA_new: 信じないなら、外に出てみろ！墓に入りたいのか？

entries.EN: Rest in peace, faithless! May your souls be forgiven...
entries.JA_current: Rest in peace, faithless! May your souls be forgiven...
entries.JA_new: 信じなかった奴らよ、安らかに眠れ。魂が赦されますように……

entries.EN: Additional measurements made it clear that the previous warning had been a mistake...
entries.JA_current: Additional measurements made it clear that the previous warning had been a mistake...
entries.JA_new: 追加計測の結果、先ほどの警報は誤りだったと判明した……

entries.EN: The data turned out to be wrong.
entries.JA_current: The data turned out to be wrong.
entries.JA_new: データに誤りがあった。

entries.EN: The info has not been confirmed.
entries.JA_current: The info has not been confirmed.
entries.JA_new: 情報は確認できなかった。

entries.EN: The sensors have generated a wrong signal. Sorry.
entries.JA_current: The sensors have generated a wrong signal. Sorry.
entries.JA_new: センサーが誤った信号を出していた。すまない。

entries.EN: The equipment hasn't verified the previous alarms. Sorry for the mistake, stalkers.
entries.JA_current: The equipment hasn't verified the previous alarms. Sorry for the mistake, stalkers.
entries.JA_new: 前回の警報は機器で確認できなかった。ストーカー諸君、誤報を詫びる。

entries.EN: Damn you! Scum!
entries.JA_current: Damn you! Scum!
entries.JA_new: くそっ、てめえ！このクズが！

entries.EN: You're a prick, man! I've almost made my pants dirty!
entries.JA_current: You're a prick, man! I've almost made my pants dirty!
entries.JA_new: ふざけんな！漏らすところだったぞ！

entries.EN: Fuck! I've almost coughed my lungs up while running for cover!
entries.JA_current: Fuck! I've almost coughed my lungs up while running for cover!
entries.JA_new: くそっ！避難しながら肺まで吐き出しそうになった！

entries.EN: Why the hell would you fuck with everybody's heads like that, man?
entries.JA_current: Why the hell would you fuck with everybody's heads like that, man?
entries.JA_new: なんでみんなをこんなに不安にさせるんだよ？

entries.EN: You stupid idiot! Watch what you say next time!
entries.JA_current: You stupid idiot! Watch what you say next time!
entries.JA_new: この大バカ野郎！次からは言葉に気をつけろ！

entries.EN: Fuck you, man! I'll murder you some day!
entries.JA_current: Fuck you, man! I'll murder you some day!
entries.JA_new: ふざけんな！いつか殺してやるからな！

entries.EN: Damn you, shithead! Wait until I get my hands on you - you'll get buried!
entries.JA_current: Damn you, shithead! Wait until I get my hands on you - you'll get buried!
entries.JA_new: このクソ野郎！捕まえたら墓に埋めてやる！

entries.EN: I hope a pack of zombies tears you to pieces! Think it's cute to prank people like that?!
entries.JA_current: I hope a pack of zombies tears you to pieces! Think it's cute to prank people like that?!
entries.JA_new: ゾンビの群れに食いちぎられちまえ！人をからかって何が楽しいんだ？

entries.EN: Moron!
entries.JA_current: Moron!
entries.JA_new: 間抜けめ！

entries.EN: Message
entries.JA_current: Message
entries.JA_new: メッセージ

entries.EN: An emission has recently occurred in the Zone.
entries.JA_current: An emission has recently occurred in the Zone.
entries.JA_new: ゾーンで光熱放射が発生した。

entries.EN: Whew... I seem to be alive. What about you, folks?
entries.JA_current: Whew... I seem to be alive. What about you, folks?
entries.JA_new: ふう……どうやら生きてる。みんなはどうだ？

entries.EN: That was close...
entries.JA_current: That was close...
entries.JA_new: 危なかった……

entries.EN: I've almost kicked the bucket... But was lucky this time...
entries.JA_current: I've almost kicked the bucket... But was lucky this time...
entries.JA_new: 死ぬところだった……だが今回は運がよかった。

entries.EN: Ha-ha! I'm alive! ALIVE!!!
entries.JA_current: Ha-ha! I'm alive! ALIVE!!!
entries.JA_new: ハハッ！生きてる！生きてるぞ！！！

entries.EN: It can drive you mad... Finally, it's over...
entries.JA_current: It can drive you mad... Finally, it's over...
entries.JA_new: 気が狂いそうだ……やっと終わった……

entries.EN: It seems to have passed...
entries.JA_current: It seems to have passed...
entries.JA_new: どうやら収まったみたいだ……

entries.EN: I was sure I ain't gonna make it... Screw it! I'm alive! Alive and running!
entries.JA_current: I was sure I ain't gonna make it... Screw it! I'm alive! Alive and running!
entries.JA_new: もう駄目かと思った……くそっ！生きてるぞ！まだ走れる！

entries.EN: , say thanks to the Zone for having had mercy on you.
entries.JA_current: , say thanks to the Zone for having had mercy on you.
entries.JA_new: 、ゾーンに命を拾ってもらったんだ。感謝しろ。

entries.EN: . Yeah... That was close...
entries.JA_current: . Yeah... That was close...
entries.JA_new: 。ああ……危なかった……

entries.EN: ! You're alive, man! Attaboy!
entries.JA_current: ! You're alive, man! Attaboy!
entries.JA_new: ！生きてたな！やるじゃないか！

entries.EN: , shit... I got caught in it slightly... Need a medkit, please...
entries.JA_current: , shit... I got caught in it slightly... Need a medkit, please...
entries.JA_new: 、くそっ……少し巻き込まれた……メディキットをくれ……

entries.EN: , and what about the next one? Any news?
entries.JA_current: , and what about the next one? Any news?
entries.JA_new: 、次の光熱放射はどうだ？何か分かったか？

entries.EN: , say thanks to the Zone for having let you live.
entries.JA_current: , say thanks to the Zone for having let you live.
entries.JA_new: 、ゾーンに命を拾ってもらったことに感謝しろ。

entries.EN: , now you know how it looks like, don't you? That's it!
entries.JA_current: , now you know how it looks like, don't you? That's it!
entries.JA_new: 、これでゾーンの怖さが分かっただろ？そういうことさ！

entries.EN: We've got problems with our radio equipment. Difficulties with communication between field squads and HQ may be experienced for a couple of days.
entries.JA_current: We've got problems with our radio equipment. Difficulties with communication between field squads and HQ may be experienced for a couple of days.
entries.JA_new: 無線機器に不具合が発生している。野外部隊と本部の通信に、数日間支障が出る可能性がある。

entries.EN: Stop choking up the air! Your "heroic" deeds are not interesting for anybody!
entries.JA_current: Stop choking up the air! Your "heroic" deeds are not interesting for anybody!
entries.JA_new: 電波を塞ぐな！お前の「英雄的」な活躍なんか誰も聞きたくない！

entries.EN: Proceed to secure channel for security software update. If any confidential info leaks due to somebody having been too lazy to download the patch - I'll strangle him myself!
entries.JA_current: Proceed to secure channel for security software update. If any confidential info leaks due to somebody having been too lazy to download the patch - I'll strangle him myself!
entries.JA_new: セキュリティソフトを更新するため、暗号チャンネルへ移れ。パッチのダウンロードを面倒がったせいで機密情報が漏れたら、俺が締め上げるぞ！

entries.EN: All info concerning active operations and intel, including current raids against mutants, MUST be transmitted via the secure channel. No info must leak to public channels!
entries.JA_current: All info concerning active operations and intel, including current raids against mutants, MUST be transmitted via the secure channel. No info must leak to public channels!
entries.JA_new: 進行中の作戦や情報、ミュータント掃討作戦に関する情報は、すべて暗号チャンネルで送信しろ。公開チャンネルへの漏洩は厳禁だ！

entries.EN: Stalkers! Join "Duty" today. Lets protect the planet from the Zone's contagion!
entries.JA_current: Stalkers! Join "Duty" today. Lets protect the planet from the Zone's contagion!
entries.JA_new: ストーカー諸君！デューティーに参加しろ。ゾーンの脅威から地球を守ろう！

entries.EN: Skilled stalkers wanted for raids against snorks. Respective payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_current: Skilled stalkers wanted for raids against snorks. Respective payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_new: スノーク掃討に参加する腕利きストーカーを募集。報酬は保証する。

entries.EN: Skilled stalkers wanted for raids against mutants. Respective payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_current: Skilled stalkers wanted for raids against mutants. Respective payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_new: ミュータント掃討に参加する腕利きストーカーを募集。報酬は保証する。

entries.EN: Experienced stalkers wanted for raids against monsters. Respective payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_current: Experienced stalkers wanted for raids against monsters. Respective payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_new: 怪物の掃討に参加する熟練ストーカーを募集。報酬は保証する。

entries.EN: Petrenko, respond immediately, damn you! What's happened to the secure channel?! Down again?!
entries.JA_current: Petrenko, respond immediately, damn you! What's happened to the secure channel?! Down again?!
entries.JA_new: ペトレンコ、すぐ応答しろ！暗号チャンネルはどうなった？また落ちたのか！？

entries.EN: Petrenko speaking. We've got temporary problems with the secure channel. Any urgent info to be sent to my private message box.
entries.JA_current: Petrenko speaking. We've got temporary problems with the secure channel. Any urgent info to be sent to my private message box.
entries.JA_new: ペトレンコだ。暗号チャンネルに一時的な障害が出ている。急ぎの情報は俺の個人メッセージ宛てに送ってくれ。

entries.EN: General Voronin speaking. All squads, report status immediately via radio channel! We are conducting a radio muster!
entries.JA_current: General Voronin speaking. All squads, report status immediately via radio channel! We are conducting a radio muster!
entries.JA_new: ヴォロニン将軍だ。全隊、無線でただちに状況を報告しろ！無線点呼を行う！

entries.EN: Petrenko speaking. I repeat: any access to the HQ must be carried out according to valid permits or upon my personal approval only!
entries.JA_current: Petrenko speaking. I repeat: any access to the HQ must be carried out according to valid permits or upon my personal approval only!
entries.JA_new: ペトレンコだ。繰り返す。本部への立ち入りは、有効な許可証を持つ者か、俺が個別に許可した者に限る！

entries.EN: Petrenko speaking. Scouting Squad 3, we are still awaiting your status update. Report status or casualties if you have any via any means! What the hell is going on with your radio equipment?!
entries.JA_current: Petrenko speaking. Scouting Squad 3, we are still awaiting your status update. Report status or casualties if you have any via any means! What the hell is going on with your radio equipment?!
entries.JA_new: ペトレンコだ。偵察第3班、状況報告を待っている。生存者や死傷者の状況を、どんな手段でもいいから報告しろ！無線機はどうなってる！？

entries.EN: Jeka 'Captain' speaking. All squad officers to report to General Voronin!!
entries.JA_current: Jeka 'Captain' speaking. All squad officers to report to General Voronin!!
entries.JA_new: 「大尉」ジェーカだ。各班の隊長はヴォロニン将軍のもとへ集合しろ！！

entries.EN: Prapor speaking. Attention, all! Ammunition and cartridges will be distributed during hours of service only! I'm not going to spend the night here!!!
entries.JA_current: Prapor speaking. Attention, all! Ammunition and cartridges will be distributed during hours of service only! I'm not going to spend the night here!!!
entries.JA_new: 准尉プラポルだ。全員に告ぐ！弾薬の配給は勤務時間内だけだ！俺はここで夜を明かす気はないぞ！！！

entries.EN: Petrenko speaking. Squad 5! The mutant acquisition raid for the Arena has NOT been called off! Get out of the bar right NOW and get to work! No anarchist tricks will be tolerated!!!
entries.JA_current: Petrenko speaking. Squad 5! The mutant acquisition raid for the Arena has NOT been called off! Get out of the bar right NOW and get to work! No anarchist tricks will be tolerated!!!
entries.JA_new: ペトレンコだ。第5班！アリーナ向けのミュータント調達作戦は中止していない！今すぐバーを出て任務に戻れ！勝手な反抗は許さん！！！

entries.EN: Petrenko speaking. Squads 1 to 4! I repeat, squads 1 to 4 only! Square thirteen, helix nine, chart six. Entrance to the area is denied until 1700 tomorrow. High activity of mutants expected.
entries.JA_current: Petrenko speaking. Squads 1 to 4! I repeat, squads 1 to 4 only! Square thirteen, helix nine, chart six. Entrance to the area is denied until 1700 tomorrow. High activity of mutants expected.
entries.JA_new: ペトレンコだ。第1班から第4班へ。繰り返す、第1班から第4班のみ！スクエア13、ヘリックス9、チャート6。明日17時まで区域への立ち入りを禁ずる。ミュータントの活動活発化が予想される。

entries.EN: God bless "Freedom"! Help the gifts of the Zone to make the World better!
entries.JA_current: God bless "Freedom"! Help the gifts of the Zone to make the World better!
entries.JA_new: フリーダムに栄光あれ！ゾーンの恵みで世界をより良くしよう！

entries.EN: Join "Freedom"! Stop the usurpation of the Zone!
entries.JA_current: Join "Freedom"! Stop the usurpation of the Zone!
entries.JA_new: フリーダムに参加しろ！ゾーンの独占を止めよう！

entries.EN: Experienced stalkers wanted to raid for artifacts. Generous payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_current: Experienced stalkers wanted to raid for artifacts. Generous payment guaranteed.
entries.JA_new: アーティファクト探索に参加する熟練ストーカーを募集。報酬は弾む。

entries.EN: Free stalkers! Listen to the voice of "Freedom"! If you're seeking a better life in the Zone without having to take orders from stupid jarheads and play soldier like they do in "Duty" - come and join us! You are always welcome!
entries.JA_current: Free stalkers! Listen to the voice of "Freedom"! If you're seeking a better life in the Zone without having to take orders from stupid jarheads and play soldier like they do in "Duty" - come and join us! You are always welcome!
entries.JA_new: ローナーたちよ、フリーダムの声を聞け！ゾーンでより良い暮らしを求めているが、頭の固い軍人どもの命令に従い、デューティーの連中のように兵隊ごっこをするのは嫌だろう？それなら俺たちに加われ！いつでも歓迎する！

entries.EN: All of our lot - connect to the secure channel urgently to get the security software updated. Otherwise, never complain about "Duty" somehow being aware of our movements.
entries.JA_current: All of our lot - connect to the secure channel urgently to get the security software updated. Otherwise, never complain about "Duty" somehow being aware of our movements.
entries.JA_new: フリーダムの仲間は全員、セキュリティソフトを更新するため、ただちに暗号チャンネルへ接続しろ。さもないと、デューティーがなぜ俺たちの動きを知っているのかと文句を言うことになるぞ。

entries.EN: When on a mission, transmit every byte of info via the secure channel. Don't be idiots to think that only our lot keeps reading that.
entries.JA_current: When on a mission, transmit every byte of info via the secure channel. Don't be idiots to think that only our lot keeps reading that.
entries.JA_new: 任務中の情報は、どんな些細なことでも暗号チャンネルで送れ。聞いているのが俺たちだけだと思い込むな。
